title: Test first-return signs before composing positive endpoints as renewal
statement: The exact paired Schur operator has one positive and two negative offdiagonal entries on a triangle; a diagonal phase cannot remove that sign. Thus nonnegative endpoints do not produce a homogeneous nonnegative literal-boundary first-return kernel, even with arbitrarily many finite auxiliary states. The1/7868U=1 bound is interface-specific.
